headline: Why Tesla and SpaceX are rising together: TSMC Terafab and merger speculation fuel Musk rally
summary: Tesla and SpaceX shares rallied strongly through October 20 amid discussions of a TSMC Terafab chip facility and speculative investor expectations of a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger. No formal merger announcement exists, but the combination of shared leadership under Elon Musk and the chip plant discussions has attracted momentum-driven buyers into both names simultaneously.
key_facts: No formal Tesla-SpaceX merger announced
Investor speculation around combined Musk entity driving correlated rally
Tesla hovering around $382 premarket ahead of Q3 earnings
SpaceX +17% three-session rally

headline: Microsoft Q1 FY2026 earnings: Revenue $77.7B +18% YoY; Azure grew 40%
summary: Microsoft reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $77.7 billion, up 18% year-over-year, with Azure and other cloud services growing 40% in the quarter. The result demonstrated continued strong enterprise cloud demand and set a high baseline ahead of the upcoming Q2 FY2027 report due October 28.
key_facts: Q1 FY2026 revenue: $77.7B (+18% YoY)
Azure cloud growth: +40%

headline: 10-year Treasury yield at ~5.0% heading into FOMC; stocks defensive as rate uncertainty persists
summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield stood at approximately 5.0% heading into the October 26–28 week, with the Federal Reserve's rate decision due Wednesday. Elevated yields reflect persistent inflation concerns amid Middle East-driven energy costs and a September Fed hike that brought the policy rate to 3.75%–4.00%.
key_facts: 10-year Treasury yield: ~5.0% heading into FOMC week
September Fed hike brought funds rate to 3.75%–4.00%
Elevated yields reflecting persistent inflation and energy cost concerns

headline: ASX recovers from early selloff to close marginally higher Monday Oct 26; Zip Co +11%
summary: Australia's ASX 200 recovered from a sharp early selloff to close marginally higher on Monday October 26. Zip Co was the top mover in the ASX 200, gaining approximately 11%, while Vulcan Energy rose about 6.3%. Markets were tracking Wall Street's prior week selloff and monitored oil price moves ahead of the RBA's policy calendar.
key_facts: ASX 200 closed marginally higher after early selloff on Oct 26
Zip Co: +11% top ASX 200 mover
Vulcan Energy: +6.3%
RBA rate hike odds tracked above 60% per markets

headline: Gold spot trading around $4,170-$4,200/oz in mid-October 2026 as geopolitical safe-haven demand persists
summary: Gold prices were trading in the $4,170–$4,200 per troy ounce range in mid-October 2026, supported by geopolitical safe-haven demand tied to Middle East tensions and uncertainty about the Federal Reserve's rate path. A firmer US dollar and the approach of US inflation data kept the upside limited.
key_facts: Gold spot ~$4,170–$4,200/oz range in mid-October 2026
Geopolitical safe-haven demand supporting price
Firm US dollar limiting gold upside
